exchanges: good morning! suns out for once
Lovely, enjoy the sunshine!
been practising my accordion on the porch, the neighbours are being very patient
Porch concerts are a gift, whether they know it or not.
my fingers are stiff but its coming along
Steady practice will loosen them up.
had a long call with my sister philippa yesterday
Lovely to catch up with family.
she sold the old house finally
End of an era, that's a big step.
shes moving to harrogate to be near her kids
Being close to family makes a lot of sense.
neighbour hollis came by with tomatoes from his garden
Fresh garden tomatoes are the best.
turns out he grew up in inverkip, right by the water
A seaside childhood, how nice.
we talked boats for an hour
Sounds like a great chat.
reading gilead again, it gets better every time
Some books really reward coming back to them.
rafe called too, my grandson, hes in his first year
Exciting time for him!
hes doing forestry, wants to work outdoors
That suits someone who loves the outdoors.
says the dorm food is dreadful
A rite of passage, I'm afraid.
tallowmere has a lovely campus though, we visited in the summer
A nice campus makes up for a lot.
choir tonight, were doing sea shanties
Fun, hope you're in good voice!
the other hollis, from choir, says hes an aberfoyle lad originally
Two Hollises with very different roots, funny.
after choir we always go for pie
Pie after singing sounds perfect.
bramblewood diner is my go-to, best rhubarb pie in the county
A good pie spot is worth its weight in gold.
my granddaughter set up my new phone, i cant work it
New phones take some getting used to.
its a motorola, buttons are tiny
Bumping up the text size might help.
my old pal everett phoned to laugh at me about it
Good friends always find the funny side.
rafe says he gets the ferry across to campus every morning
What a scenic way to start the day.
makes me want to visit again
Sounds like a lovely trip to plan.
right, off to bed. goodnight
Goodnight, sleep well!
